items.Sentence: The headworks include a rotary hydroscreen system, a screenings washer, and a metering flume.
the third cell contains a 3-horsepower aerator, set on a timer, to create aerobic and anoxic conditions within the pond
a settling pond (also known as the North Pond) is used for storage during high flows and for filter backwashes
the secondary effluent is pre-chlorinated using sodium hypochlorite prior to filtration

Tertiary treatment is achieved in the microfiltration system. The microfiltration system consists of two treatment trains each with a holding tank, strainer, and three banks of 12 microza microfiltration modules
chlorine disinfection with sodium hypochlorite ... Sodium hypochlorite is injected into the 8-inch influent line prior to entering the chlorine contact tank
the chlorinated effluent is dechlorinated using sodium bisulfite
Biosolids generated during the treatment process accumulate in the aeration and settling ponds, where they undergo anaerobic digestion and densification.
approximately 99 dry tons of solids were removed from the ponds and land applied by Synagro Technologies, Inc.
The cleaned and dewatered solids are disposed of at a landfill.
